named_duties: STATE A17 FORMALLY. The BATCH-001 transcription numbers it among A1-A23 and the red team identified it as an UNSTATED i.i.d. assumption about the inner decoder, unproved in EITHER the specification OR HQC-RMRS. Write it as a precise mathematical statement: what is assumed independent of what, over which probability space, at which step of the concatenated RM/RS decoding chain. If the transcription's phrasing is ambiguous, say so and give every reading you can distinguish - an ambiguous assumption cannot be tested.

SEARCH BOTH SOURCES FOR A PROOF. Systematically search the specification and arXiv:2005.10741 for any lemma, proposition, remark or appendix that establishes A17, weakens it, or acknowledges it. Record the search method and every location checked, so a negative result is a SEARCHED negative and not an unsearched one. docs/inventor-protocol.md: a negative claim needs a named obstruction, not a fatigue report.

DERIVE THE SENSITIVITY. If A17 fails - if inner-decoder failures are positively correlated rather than independent - which way does the DFR bound move, and by how much as a function of the correlation? Give the derivation, not an assertion. State explicitly whether a violation makes the published DFR OPTIMISTIC (the security-relevant direction) or PESSIMISTIC, and under what conditions each holds. If the direction cannot be determined without measurement, say that plainly - that is itself the result that justifies the eventual experiment.

CHECK WHETHER A17 IS LOAD-BEARING. Trace which of the transcribed results actually depend on it: Prop 6.1.3, Prop 6.1.4, Theorem 6.1, the delta-correctness join, or only some. An assumption that only affects a discarded intermediate bound is not the target it appears to be. Be willing to conclude A17 is NOT the best target and name a better one from A1-A23 if the trace shows that.

NULL-OBJECT DISCIPLINE. Before reporting that A17 matters, state what you would expect to see if it did NOT - i.e. what an assumption that is merely conventional bookkeeping looks like in this same trace - and check A17 against that. docs/inventor-protocol.md requires controls before belief.
constraints: DO NOT DESIGN AN EXPERIMENT. No protocol, no parameter selection, no trial count, no seed strategy, no success criterion. RQ-HQC-001.constraints[0] forbids experiment design until the sources are FILED, and filing is a sibling task whose outcome you must not assume.
